name: me
description: ME — a personal knowledge base plugin for a three-layer knowledge flywheel and evidence-backed decision briefs.

interface.shortDescription: Turn any workspace into a Git + Markdown knowledge flywheel.
interface.longDescription: ME gives Codex skills for managing a three-layer knowledge vault: ingest research, build evidence-backed decision briefs, record practices, distill cognition, maintain wikilinks, and search Markdown notes without external infrastructure.
defaultPrompt: Initialize this workspace as a ME vault.
Use $me:update to preview and confirm forward-only ME vault migrations after upgrading the plugin.
Ingest this URL into my knowledge base.
Build a decision brief from my local evidence.
